notablePrerequisites:
Belisarius Cawl does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other untapped artifact creatures.
description:
Activate Belisarius Cawl's first ability by tapping it and two other artifact creatures you control, creating a 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature token.
The Astartes Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
